name: Christmas Island Internet Administration
summary: Community-owned, non-profit ISP (Christmas Island Internet Administration Limited, CIIA) serving Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands; established Mar 2000 from the assets of IOComm; the sole ISP for the Indian Ocean Territories from c. 2001; also operator of the .cx ccTLD; ceased services 1 Mar 2017.

events.details: Established as a community-owned non-profit; purchased the assets of former ISP IOComm.
Assumed the Cocos (Keeling) Islands ISP infrastructure (assets gifted by eNIC in 2005).
Ceased internet services; could not compete with the subsidised NBN; service taken over by Speedcast.
